title: Cloud Hypervisor regression admission rejects a regional Actions OIDC endpoint
symptoms: Cloud Hypervisor regression profiles reject before broker startup
conditions: The authorized ordinary-workflow regression profile uses a regional HTTPS endpoint within .actions.githubusercontent.com
Older code accepts only the previously recognized Actions endpoint form
An old aggregate admission failure without a subreason does not prove this was its cause
rootCause: The regression admission token acquisition guard was narrower than valid regional GitHub Actions OIDC endpoint shapes, so otherwise eligible runs could fail before broker or engine startup.

probe.expect: Use only the existing allowlisted admission subreason and source/workflow profile metadata. Do not read, decode, print or exchange the Actions token or request URL. Historical aggregate reasons remain unknown.

action: Use source containing regional endpoint validation and finite admission subreasons with the exact signed ordinary-workflow profile. Keep HTTPS namespace, signature, claims, source pins, runtime, artifact and storage requirements. Let AWF create its work directory so a harness-owned directory does not create secondary cleanup rejection. Hosted acceptance remains separate.
